description: This file serves as a header file defining functions and constants related to WPA Supplicant configuration management, including creation and update functions, as well as a directory path macro.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_cfgFile_create
methods.description: Creates a WPA Supplicant configuration file for a specified endpoint.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_cfgFile_createExt
methods.description: Creates a WPA Supplicant configuration file with extended parameters.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_cfgFile_globalConfigUpdate
methods.description: Updates the global configuration of the WPA Supplicant configuration file.

methods.name: wld_wpaSupp_cfgFile_networkConfigUpdate
methods.description: Updates the network-specific configuration within the WPA Supplicant configuration file.
